dedupe_keys.name: gr plw6 y07y11 greek national electricity load ipto and weather from six stations 2007 to 2011

description: This Zenodo package, released in July 2016 by Harris V. Georgiou of the Department of Informatics and Telecommunications at the National and Kapodistrian University of Athens, supports short-term power load forecasting research. It contains two sets of data: five years of power load logs for the whole of Greece from January 2007 to December 2011, as registered by the Independent Power Transmission Operator (IPTO, ADMIE), and eight years of weather data from six measuring stations in major mainland areas, as registered by the NOAA Satellite and Information Service. The data are stored as MATLAB and Octave workspace files in a 7z archive of about 2.7 MB, with a readme and a terms-of-use file, and are available for free download under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; the author asks users to accept the included end user licence. Coverage is Greece. Caveats: the series end in 2011, non-commercial terms apply, and the native format needs MATLAB, Octave or a converter. Simulation uses are national hourly load with matching weather for load forecasting and demand model calibration. Related records: data-greece-10-turbine-wind-farm-scada-2020 is another Greek power dataset.
